title: Exercise: cooling tower at nominal and half fan speed

verification.notes: 59 common variables, 1 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 0. The tool prints the largest relative difference as 1.60e-01, on T_w_ex_set (exact 0.159992924904: CoolSolve 29.4002476284 °C, EES 35 °C). The equation window does not assign theta. The next largest relative difference is 6.515e-04 on cp_a_f, from humid-air properties, EES 7.458 vs CoolProp AirH2O. T_w_ex is 25.555026 °C against 25.554937 °C; T_w_ex_r is 29.400248 °C against 29.400619 °C; Q_dot is 1.977305 MW against 1.977324 MW; Q_dot_r is 1.172308 MW against 1.172230 MW; M_dot_a is 60 kg/s and M_dot_a_r is 30 kg/s; W_dot_r and W_dot_mean are 1875 W.
